newsitem.title: USA: ECRI monthly U.S. inflation gauge 107.9 in Feb.
newsitem.headline: ECRI monthly U.S. inflation gauge 107.9 in Feb.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) monthly future inflation gauge (FIG) rose to 107.9 in February from a revised 107.5 reading in the prior month, ECRI said.
The smooth annualized growth rate rose to 1.7 percent in the second month of 1997 from 0.8 in January.
"The (FIG) gauge has just recently begun to go up noticeably, and will indicate an upturn in inflation pressures only if it continues to rise for a few months," the report said.
